need: Flashcard decks must expose quiz as a deck-specific capability: only eligible decks offer a quiz action, while every reviewable deck keeps its review action.
negativeBoundary: Do not imply that quiz is only a course-wide global mode, show a quiz action on every deck without eligibility evidence, or hide review behind an ambiguous generic Start action.
acceptanceCriteria: Each deck exposes an explicit review action labelled `> Ôn` in Vietnamese.
A deck exposes a quiz action only when the backend-proven or deterministically derived eligibility rule is satisfied.
Starting a deck quiz scopes the persisted card draw to that deck rather than silently mixing the whole course.
Ineligible decks remain reviewable and do not render a dead quiz control.
Tests cover at least one eligible and one ineligible deck and prove the submitted card IDs.

accepts: Review remains available on each reviewable deck.
Quiz appears only on decks that can produce a valid quiz draw.
rejects: One generic deck action that hides the operation being started.
A course-wide quiz affordance presented as if it were deck-specific.
